title: Aider: The AI Coding Agent That Lives in Your Terminal#Shorts #aider
description:
Stop paying $20 a month for AI coding tools — Aider does the same job for the cost of your own API calls.

✅ Edit real files across your entire repo with one natural-language command — ship complete features in minutes, not hours.
✅ Switch between Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini, and local Llama instantly. No plan tiers, no model lock-in.
✅ 46,998 GitHub stars and growing, backed by an active community shipping updates weekly.
✅ Automatic git commits with AI-written messages — every change is tracked and reversible.

📊 How it stacks up against paid tools:
• Cursor Pro — $20/month ($200/year) — locks you into their editor
• GitHub Copilot — $10/month ($19/user/mo business) — subscription, single provider
• Windsurf Pro — ~$15/month — usage caps
• Aider — FREE. Terminal-based, runs in any editor, pay-per-token with your own key. No subscription, no cloud upload, no lock-in.

⭐ 46,998 stars · 🐍 Python · 📄 Apache 2.0 license

🔗 Repo: https://github.com/Aider-AI/aider
Install: pip install aider-chat

🔔 Subscribe to GithubTrends for weekly GitHub highlights
